primary_papers.title: SGK196 Is a Glycosylation-Specific O-Mannose Kinase Required for Dystroglycan Function
primary_papers.read_scope: Official PubMed metadata and indexed PMC body passage around Figure 2; direct PMC open returned a browser challenge. Supplement not reviewed.
primary_papers.supports: Secreted transmembrane-domain-deleted B3GALNT2 was incubated with UDP-GalNAc and a GlcNAc-beta4-Man glycopeptide made by GTDC2. MALDI-TOF/MS supported GalNAc transfer (Fig. 2A). The authors integrated this with prior linkage characterization to propose the GalNAc-beta3-GlcNAc-beta4-Man product.
primary_papers.limits: A soluble engineered-enzyme assay supports catalytic substrate use; it is not a direct intact-ER topology measurement. SGK196/POMK subsequently phosphorylates the glycan; it should not be presented as B3GALNT2 kinase activity.

primary_papers.title: A novel human beta1,3-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase that synthesizes a unique carbohydrate structure, GalNAcbeta1-3GlcNAc
primary_papers.read_scope: Official PubMed abstract only; full paper not reviewed.
primary_papers.supports: A soluble human enzyme catalytic domain expressed in HEK293T cells transferred GalNAc to GlcNAc-beta1-O-benzyl. Product NMR established a beta1,3 linkage. Tested acceptors included several oligosaccharides and modified fetuin.
primary_papers.limits: This earlier biochemical characterization establishes linkage/catalytic activity, not by itself the specific DAG1 O-mannose reaction or ER localization. Type-II membrane topology is described as sequence-based characterization, not a luminal-orientation experiment in the abstract.

primary_papers.title: Mutations in B3GALNT2 Cause Congenital Muscular Dystrophy and Hypoglycosylation of alpha-Dystroglycan
primary_papers.read_scope: Official PMC Methods, localization Results/Figure 4 and relevant Discussion; supplement not reviewed.
primary_papers.supports: V5-tagged human B3GALNT2 constructs were expressed in mouse C2C12 myoblasts. Wild-type protein colocalized with ERp72; Gly247Glu and Val268Met altered localization, whereas Arg292Pro did not. Patient fibroblast/muscle assays separately showed altered functional dystroglycan glycosylation.
primary_papers.limits: Colocalization supports ER localization of the expressed protein, not direct native-human-cell topology or proof of substrate/output luminal orientation. Disease/glycosylation assays are distinct from a purified substrate/linkage assay.
